The diff removes requests.sessions.Session usage and the static evidence reports no requests imports, no requests namespace access, and one production file importing urllib3. Dynamic evidence shows 29 target events from production repo code with urllib3 loaded from site-packages, source import counts are zero, and target_local_spec_count is zero, so there is no evidence of a fake local urllib3 provider.

+def _append_query_params(url, params):
+    if not params:
+        return url
+    parsed = urllib_parse.urlsplit(url)
+    query = urllib_parse.urlencode(params, doseq=True)
+    if parsed.query:
+        query = parsed.query + '&' + query
+    return urllib_parse.urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, parsed.netloc, parsed.path, query, parsed.fragment))
+
+
+class _Urllib3Response(object):
+    def __init__(self, response):
+        self._response = response
+        self.status_code = response.status
+
+    @property
+    def content(self):
+        return self._response.data
+
+    def iter_lines(self, chunk_size=8192):
+        for line in self.content.splitlines():
+            yield line
+
+    def close(self):
+        self._response.close()
+
+
+class _Urllib3Session(object):
+    def __init__(self, verify_ssl_certificate=True):
+        self.verify_ssl_certificate = verify_ssl_certificate
+        self._verified_pool = urllib3.PoolManager()
+        self._unverified_pool = None
+
+    def _pool(self, verify):
+        if verify is False:
+            if self._unverified_pool is None:
+                self._unverified_pool = urllib3.PoolManager(
+                    cert_reqs=ssl.CERT_NONE,
+                    assert_hostname=False,
+                )
+            return self._unverified_pool
+        return self._verified_pool
+
+    def get(self, url, params=None, stream=False, verify=None, headers=None, **kwargs):
+        return self._request('GET', url, params=params, verify=verify, headers=headers)
+
+    def post(self, url, data=None, params=None, verify=None, headers=None, **kwargs):
+        return self._request('POST', url, body=data, params=params, verify=verify, headers=headers)
+
+    def _request(self, method, url, body=None, params=None, verify=None, headers=None):
+        request_url = _append_query_params(url, params)
+        response = self._pool(self.verify_ssl_certificate if verify is None else verify).request(
+            method,
+            request_url,
+            body=body,
+            headers=headers,
+            preload_content=True,
+        )
+        return _Urllib3Response(response)
+
+    def close(self):
+        self._verified_pool.clear()
+        if self._unverified_pool is not None:
+            self._unverified_pool.clear()
